  • Constructor Details

    • UserEntity

      protected UserEntity()
      Default no-argument constructor required by JPA specification. Protected visibility prevents direct instantiation without initial values while still allowing Hibernate to create instances via reflection.

    • UserEntity

      public UserEntity(String username, String email, String passwordHash, UserRole role)
      Convenience constructor for creating a new user instance before persisting.
      Parameters:
      username - the user's unique username
      email - the user's email address
      passwordHash - the BCrypt-hashed password
      role - the user's assigned security role

    • addTask

      public void addTask(TaskEntity task)
      Synchronizes bidirectional relationship when adding a task to this user. Keeps the in-memory object graph consistent with the database state.
      Parameters:
      task - the task to associate with this user

    • removeTask

      public void removeTask(TaskEntity task)
      Synchronizes bidirectional relationship when removing a task from this user.
      Parameters:
      task - the task to disassociate

    • getAuthorities

      public Collection<? extends org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority> getAuthorities()
      Returns the authorities (roles/permissions) granted to this user. Spring Security checks these during authorization (e.g. @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')")).
      Specified by:
      getAuthorities in interface org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails
      Returns:
      a list containing the user's role wrapped in SimpleGrantedAuthority
